findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_tender_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The categories of tender open on BinaSmart right now and how many are in each — useful before calling list_tenders with a category filter.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_events, list_films, search_knowledge, find_pool_groups, list_news, list_cinema_showtimes · Private data: list_overseas_agencies · Public sink: list_overseas_agencies, list_pool_corridors, find_pool_groups, get_tender, list_cinema_showtimes · Destructive: request_ride.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_events, list_films, search_knowledge, find_pool_groups, list_news, list_cinema_showtimes · Private data: list_overseas_agencies · Public sink: list_overseas_agencies, list_pool_corridors, find_pool_groups, get_tender, list_cinema_showtimes · Destructive: request_ride

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
